LESSON: READING ALOUD

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: READING Theme 7. My Body
Topic 2.9: Reading aloud
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading aloud, part of READING Theme 7. My Body in Grade 4 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: How do we become fluent while reading?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read sentences on the home aloud, e.g Mutter kocht in der Küche,

2. read texts aloud on the home with peers,

3. read aloud flashcards on home in turns.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read sentences on the home aloud, e.g Mutter kocht in der Küche,
2. read texts aloud on the home with peers,
3. read aloud flashcards on home in turns.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading aloud together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: The learner develops teamwork skills as they read aloud flashcards on the home in

turns.

Values:
Unity: The learner works collaboratively as they read texts aloud on the home with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social Cohesion: The learner develops an awareness of family dynamics as they read sentences on the home aloud; e.g

Mutter kocht in der Küche.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner links the concept of the home to the same concept in Agriculture.
